videos.headline: Gabriela Jaquez knocks down a huge 3 for UCLA
videos.description: Gabriela Jaquez makes a huge 3-pointer to extend UCLA's lead late against LSU.

videos.headline: UCLA takes down LSU to advance to first Final Four
videos.description: Lauren Betts and Gabriela Jaquez combine to score 35 points as UCLA defeats LSU in the Elite Eight.
